title: Proposed Math Academy completed-activity export
description: Proposed export of one completed Math Academy activity, based on 17 inspected examples across all six activity types. See the companion data dictionary for observed per-type layouts and field availability.
$comment: Based on authenticated rendered-DOM inspection on 2026-09-24. Diagnostic and Supplemental Diagnostic share the observed testAnswers result layout; preserve their distinct activity types. This is an export schema, not the internal platform schema. No schema assertion proves availability of a field for every type. JSON Schema cannot verify DOM completeness, source truth, timezone inference, question-index uniqueness, or group-reference integrity; check those separately.

schema_version.description: Version of this proposed export format, not a platform schema version.

task_id.description: Observed task identifier; preserve as a string.

activity_type.description: Literal activity-type distinction requested for this export. A shared result layout does not merge types.

task_name.description: Displayed task title; not necessarily a catalog topic name.

status.description: Normalized status if supported by observation. Completed is observed; other statuses are not restricted by this schema.

completed_date_raw.description: Date heading from the completed feed or another explicit source. Usually unavailable in the detail header; cite the source in completed_at_provenance.

completed_at_local.description: Normalized local date and time, without claiming a verified timezone/UTC instant. Preserve provenance, especially when joined from the CSV.

completed_time_raw.description: Raw displayed completion time, which may omit date, year, and timezone.

completed_at.description: Normalized completion instant only with supported date/year/zone; otherwise null or absent. Retain raw display.

xp_raw.description: Exact XP display, retaining whether a denominator and unit were shown.

xp_earned.description: Signed earned XP; may be negative, zero, or greater than xp_possible. Not a correctness count.

xp_possible.description: Displayed XP denominator only; null if no denominator is shown. Do not infer from question count.

course_label_raw.description: Task-specific optional course label. Do not substitute global current-course sidebar state.

course_id.description: Explicitly observed or documented derived course identifier.

course_code.description: Catalog/course code if joined, with provenance; not assumed to be exposed by the task result.

topic_id.description: Main task topic ID only if supported by a main task-topic link or a documented join.

topic_url.description: Observed main task-topic link, when available.

prerequisites.description: Ordered task prerequisite links. Empty means verified absence; null means unavailable or not inspected.

context.description: Shared scenario/setup only if present; null when unavailable. Do not reconstruct unshown context without provenance.

result_layout.description: Observed layout/container name. Suggested descriptions: lesson_groups, review_flat, test_flat, multistep_flat; extensible for new evidence.

question_count.description: Derived count of question occurrences, independent of XP and correctness.

knowledge_point_group_count.description: Derived lesson-group count; null for no applicable grouping or unknown grouping.

knowledge_point_groups.description: Optional ordered lesson groups referring to question occurrence indices; null for ungrouped or unknown layout. Do not duplicate question records here.

question_results.description: All observed question occurrences in source order. Array may be empty only if that is the observed record; capture completeness must be stated.

derived_result_counts.description: Optional derived counts keyed by observed result label. Labels are extensible and separate from XP.

provenance.description: Additional field-level source and normalization notes.

unavailable_fields.description: Explicitly unavailable or uninspected fields; distinguish absence from empty content.

sourceObservation.description: Evidence for a capture. Capture timestamp is required; schema validity alone does not establish completeness.

captured_at.description: Exporter capture instant including a timezone offset.

source_url.description: Page URL captured; may repeat activity URL.

source_selector.description: Observed container selector or scoped locator.

capture_method.description: For example rendered_dom; describe the actual method used.

capture_scope.description: What was inspected: header, all loaded question/explanation elements, expanded samples, etc.

capture_complete.description: Whether all content in the stated scope was captured; not a claim that all possible platform fields are known.

expanded_question_indices.description: Occurrence indices whose explanation expansion was verified.

notes.description: Capture caveats, unloaded content, or sampling limits.

provenance.description: Field-level observation, inference, join, or normalization evidence. Suggested labels are not platform enums.

field.description: Field name or JSON Pointer in this export.

source_path.description: Local evidence path if using a documented file/catalog join.

source_selector.description: Element/attribute or scoped selector providing the source value.

raw_value.description: Raw source value before normalization; may be any JSON value.

basis.description: For example observed, parsed, derived, inferred, or unknown.

method.description: How a value was parsed, computed, or joined.

timezone.description: Named or numeric timezone used, if any.

timezone_verified.description: Whether timezone came from verified source evidence, rather than an assumption.

missingField.description: A missingness record distinguishes unavailable, not applicable, uninspected, and explicitly empty data.

reason.description: Extensible reason, such as not_shown, not_inspected, not_applicable, or empty_display.

topicLink.description: An observed topic link, or documented derived topic relation.

topic_id.description: Topic identifier, distinct from task/question/knowledge-point IDs.

name.description: Displayed link text, not assumed to equal a canonical topic title.

knowledgePointGroup.description: An ordered lesson KP group. The result title alone may expose no numeric KP ID.

title_raw.description: Displayed group title, including KP prefix/number if shown.

name.description: Parsed subskill name, retaining raw title separately.

knowledge_point_id.description: Only when independently observed or verified; do not derive from displayed KP 1 ordinal.

knowledge_point_url.description: Observed link if present; usually absent in inspected lesson group titles.

topic_id.description: Topic reference if supported by evidence.

question_indices.description: Ordered references to activity question_results[].occurrence_index, not question IDs.

questionResult.description: One displayed question occurrence. Its primary export key is task_id plus occurrence_index; question_id may repeat across tasks or occurrences.

occurrence_index.description: One-based ordered occurrence within this task; use as task-local primary key.

question_id.description: Observed question content ID; not assumed globally unique as an attempt identifier.

question_number.description: Parsed displayed question number, if unambiguous.

group_index.description: Parent lesson KP-group index when applicable.

knowledge_point_name.description: Displayed subskill/KP link or group name; not necessarily topic title.

knowledge_point_id.description: ID from an observed topic-link fragment; null if unavailable.

knowledge_point_href_raw.description: Original observed href, including topic path and KP fragment.

topic_id.description: Topic ID from the per-question link, separate from the fragment KP ID.

prompt_graphics.description: Ordered graphics in prompt or adjacent question graphic frame.

difficulty.description: Normalized difficulty only if observed class/label supports it; leave vocabulary extensible.

answered_at_raw.description: Exact answerCreated display; may omit year/timezone, and may equal completion time for every assessment question.

answered_at_local.description: Normalized local answer date/time only if the year is supported. Task 4748206 demonstrates that the task completion year cannot be assigned automatically.

answered_at.description: Normalized timestamp only with adequate evidence; not automatically an individually measured answer instant.

elapsed_raw.description: Exact elapsed display from .timeElpased, preserving format.

result_raw.description: Literal result label; do not infer from answer-region presence.

result.description: Normalized result; Correct/Incorrect observed, but labels remain extensible.

explanation_present.description: Whether paired explanation element was loaded; hidden is still present.

explanation_expanded.description: Observed visibility during capture, independent of content presence.

student_answer_present.description: Whether separate studentAnswer region exists; null when uninspected.

student_answer_state.description: Exporter description such as not_shown, no_answer_label, shown, or unknown. Missing region and literal No answer are distinct.

student_answer.description: Separate displayed learner response only, not automatically an inline prompt blank.

displayed_answer_parts.description: Ordered prompt textbox/answer positions. Multiple parts still have one question-level result; do not invent per-part grading.

choices.description: Observed choice list only. Null/absent means original choices were not exposed or not inspected, not that no options originally existed.

richContent.description: Ordered rich content, preserving mathematical/graphic structure. Null means unavailable; empty observed strings remain empty strings.

html.description: Sanitized observed markup; preserve semantic math, content order, and answer positions.

text.description: Searchable normalized text; document math conversion and avoid duplicating visual/assistive MathJax copies.

tables.description: Optional structured table representations; retain surrounding order via position metadata.

answer_parts.description: Inline blank/select/answer positions scoped to this question/content.

mathContent.description: One formula. Original TeX is optional and must not be claimed when only rendered MathML was observed.

index.description: One-based occurrence in this rich content.

mathml.description: Observed assistive MathML preserving fraction/matrix/script structure.

tex.description: Original or explicitly converted TeX, with provenance identifying which.

display.description: Whether formula is displayed/block rather than inline if observed.

asset.description: Observed graphic/image reference. Opaque filenames do not establish image meaning.

index.description: One-based order within the relevant content.

alt.description: Observed alternative text; preserve empty string if explicitly empty.

media_type.description: Observed or verified MIME type when available.

context.description: Region such as questionGraphicFrame, prompt, graphic, explanation, or student answer.

table.description: Optional table extraction; cell content can contain math and graphics.

index.description: One-based table order in rich content.

html.description: Observed table markup, preserving row/column spans.

answerPart.description: A question-local displayed answer position. A visible textbox value may be a correct answer or may remain empty; it is not necessarily the submitted answer.

index.description: One-based answer-position order within the question.

dom_id.description: Observed local ID such as freeResponseTextbox-1; IDs repeat across questions.

widget_kind.description: Observed field/widget type; no closed platform vocabulary is asserted.

displayed_value.description: Exact displayed value. Empty string does not prove no student response; null means value unavailable.

value_role.description: Exporter interpretation only when verified, such as displayed_correct_answer, unfilled_result_field, or unknown.

source_selector.description: Question-scoped locator, never an unscoped repeated DOM ID.

choice.description: Only an actually observed choice option, not a Roman-numbered statement in the prompt.

selected.description: Only explicit visible selected-state evidence; null when unavailable.
